analysis: Documentation-only change to docs/architecture/inference.md; the changed head range is 1742-1868, adding a 'Native Flint' section. The supplied units (head lines 416-1235) are unchanged surrounding text, so there is no new executable behavior in them. I examined the surrounding text for statements that could weaken security assumptions in the threat model. These were the prefix-cache/SSD text (T-041), the Nemotron Super coordinator text prefix reuse 'partitioned by authenticated cache scope and off without one', the media/image handling, and the MTP and deadline docs. All of these are consistent with existing threat entries. The visible patch excerpt (Flint loader, prefill, strict tensor validation, native KV) is truncated, and the added lines fall outside the supplied units. I could not verify the full Flint section or any associated source changes (FlintModel, the CBv2 adapter, the loader, Flint+PrefillOutput.swift). If the PR also adds code, it needs separate review for these areas: checkpoint loading and tensor validation (A-004, T-012, T-027), cache identity and prefix-cache handling for the new model_type (T-041), and CBv2 adapter admission. The docs claim a strict loader that rejects missing, extra and duplicate tensors, which is a documented control that I did not verify. No concrete security regression or invalidated assumption is visible in the supplied evidence.
